title: Pickle Ball Avatar
style: Jazz pop phonk with swung 110 bpm bounce, rubbery sub kicks, clipped snare taps, and playful off-kilter groove; verse stays sparse with close-mic lead and playful spoken ad-libs, pre-chorus lifts with stacked doubles and filtered keys, chorus hits with chanty group vocals and a sticky bass hook. Add glitchy risers, tape-stutter fills, and little crowd chants between lines; mix is glossy, punchy, and cheeky with a dark-fun snap., jazz, pop, bright
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My avatar talks back
Tells me what to wear
Pick a black cat hat
Or a grin with pickle flair

Custom out fit, clean
Fresh on the court
Got that wink-wink look
When I walk in for sport

Bright blue pickle socks
Pink drink pickle hat
I got that, I got that
Look at me like that

[Pre-Chorus]
Found my feet, found my feet
On the painted line
Hear that little click
Now I’m right on time

Tennis to pickle ball pro
That switch hit hard
Now my whole damn fit
Feels like my card

[Chorus]
Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
I am one with the ball
I am one with the ball

You want it, I got it
You want it, I got it
We together are one
We together are one

[Verse 2]
Best paddle in my hand
From the riddle I crack
Pick a pick paddle
Now I don’t look back

The sport is encumbering me
In the sweetest way
Every step on the court
Got a say in my day

I am now one with the ball
No split, no seam
Synchronisation matrix
Upgrade complete

[Pre-Chorus]
Found my feet, found my feet
On the painted line
Hear that little click
Now I’m right on time

Tennis to pickle ball pro
That switch hit hard
Now my whole damn fit
Feels like my card

[Chorus]
Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
I am one with the ball
I am one with the ball

You want it, I got it
You want it, I got it
We together are one
We together are one

[Bridge]
Talk to me, avatar
What you got to say?
He said, stay low, stay loose
And let the joy stay

I’m not just in the game
I’m the bounce, I’m the grin
One with the pickle of a ball
Let the glow sink in

[Chorus]
Pickle ball is me
Pickle ball is me
I am one with the ball
I am one with the ball

You want it, I got it
You want it, I got it
We together are one
We together are one
